rationale: Fixed-lot remains the default and the mode every pre-D029 certified result (A/E/SR0/P3/P4) is anchored to; percent-equity sizing is now validated as a correctly-functioning, fully-tested alternative (41 unit assertions, exact reconciliation to fixed-lot when volume resolution is sufficient, actual risk never exceeded requested across 2,802+ sizing decisions) for research requiring genuine risk normalization -- specifically, it is what made real executable partial-close testing possible at all. Two real bugs were found and fixed only once percent-equity mode was exercised against real backtests (symbol_exposure_cap_lots leftover fixed-lot assumption; the original active-book-state journaling attempt), both now resolved and reverified. Not FIXED_LOT_RETAINED because percent-equity mode is genuinely useful and now proven; not PERCENT_EQUITY_SIZING_RECOMMENDED as a wholesale replacement because fixed-lot's simplicity and D028's entire certified evidence base still depend on it.
